name: Three-way tie decided on head-to-head goals
source: UEFA EURO 2004, Group C, official final table. Team names replaced: Sweden=Ravens, Denmark=Dunes, Italy=Olives, Bulgaria=Roses.
why: Ravens, Dunes and Olives finished on 5 points and drew all their matches against each other (2 points, goal difference 0 each in the mini-table). Head-to-head goals scored decides: Ravens 3, Dunes 2, Olives 1.
